featured_reviews.name: RAVI SONI
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this college to take an exam and faced several issues. Firstly, there is no parking available for two-wheelers, which caused me some inconvenience. However, the main problem arose during the exam when I needed to use the washroom. All the washrooms were locked, and upon inquiry, I was informed that they are reserved exclusively for staff. My exam hall was on the 6th floor, and the security personnel directed me to the 1st floor to access a washroom. This process wasted at least 15 minutes of my exam time.

My simple question to the management is: if you cannot provide basic facilities like accessible washrooms for students, why do you designate your institution as an exam center? Students shouldn’t have to approach the admin office for such fundamental needs. Locking washrooms is unacceptable. I hope you address this issue promptly. When students come to your college for exams, they deserve basic amenities like drinking water at their desks and nearby washroom access. Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Niyati Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Peekadoodle Team and Teachers,

A huge thank you for an absolutely wonderful summer camp!

Dhruv was genuinely excited to come in every single day. As a parent, there’s no better feeling than seeing your child wake up asking, “Is it camp today?” That excitement speaks volumes about the environment you all created.

We especially loved how the hands-on activities were there in science week let the kids _do_ rather than just listen. That approach made learning new concepts so much more fun and memorable for Dhruv. He came home every afternoon with a new story, a new skill, or something cool science learning.

And the fact that there was something new every day kept the energy high and the curiosity alive. You turned each morning into an adventure he didn’t want to miss.

Thank you for your creativity, patience, and for making this summer so meaningful. You’ve made a real impact, and we’re so grateful.

featured_reviews.name: shradha dama
featured_reviews.review_text:
Peekadoodle Preschool holds a very special place in our hearts. As a parent, there’s nothing more important than knowing your child is safe, happy, and truly understood—and Peekadoodle gives you exactly that peace.

The holistic approach here is not just a concept, it’s something you actually see and feel every day. Children are not rushed or pressured—they are gently guided, loved, and encouraged to grow at their own pace. It’s beautiful to watch their confidence and curiosity bloom.

The founder’s Megha & Rushabh ‘s vision is incredibly inspiring. You can sense the passion and intention behind every little detail, creating an environment that feels warm, nurturing, and full of positivity.

The Teachers—they are the heart of Peekadoodle. Rajveer’s first teacher , his favourites Bindu Teacher & Hinal Teacher . They are so patient, so kind, and so genuinely invested. They don’t just teach, they connect. They celebrate every small milestone, making each child feel special and valued.
And also the one we looked forward to meeting everyday our co-ordinator Sejal Mam. Her contagious smile , kindness and beaming personality is unmatched.

For us, Peekadoodle is not just a preschool, it’s like a second home for our child—a place filled with love, care, and meaningful learning. We are truly grateful to have found it. ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Deepanjali Sahu
featured_reviews.review_text:
What a magical Annual Day @ Peeka-Doodle Preschool! 💫✨

Watching all the little stars light up the stage with such confidence, joy, and innocence was truly unforgettable. Each performance reflected the love, patience, and passion with which the children are nurtured here.

Seeing our little Avyan on stage, enjoying every moment with that beautiful smile, filled our hearts with pure happiness ❤️

A heartfelt thank you to all the wonderful teachers, staff, and everyone behind the scenes who made this event so seamless and special. Your dedication shines through in every confident child.

Peeka-Doodle is truly one of the best preschools we have come across — a place where children are not just taught, but lovingly shaped and encouraged to shine 🌟
